claim: In the matching retail DLL, ten Player Float32 mutation helpers form three exact structural families. AddHP, AddBP and AddSP each return immediately when isImmortal is set, add their Float32 argument to the corresponding HP/BP/SP field, clamp the field with the emitted bge.un/ble.un branches to raw bounds 0.0 and 65535.0, and, when MatchUI.inst converts true, call the corresponding SetGauge_HP/BP/SP method with PlIdx and the clamped field. SetHP, SetBP and SetSP have the same immortal gate, clamp and optional UI dispatch but replace the field directly with their Float32 argument before clamping. AddHP_Neck, AddHP_Arm, AddHP_Waist and AddHP_Leg use the same immortal gate, add and 0..65535 clamp against their exact limb fields, then return without a UI call. FACT-0020 pins the Add-family call sites in ordinary damage, including both AddSP calls, and FACT-0026 pins SetHP, SetSP and SetBP in the critical aftermath.
